title: TenK10K Phase 1 effector genes: inputs for the figures and tables
description:
Main results: tenk10k_phase1_effector_genes.v5.parquet holds the single-cell eQTL Mendelian randomisation, sensitivity and colocalisation results for every gene, cell type and trait tested in TenK10K Phase 1 (7.5 million rows); tenk10k_phase1_effector_genes.v5.md describes each column, and the descriptions are also stored in the file's metadata.

Figure and table inputs: tenk10k_figure_inputs.tar.gz holds the summary-level data needed to rebuild every figure and supplementary table of Single-cell genetics identifies cell-type-specific effector genes across complex traits and diseases (medRxiv doi:10.1101/2025.08.28.25334614) with the companion code release (make data downloads and verifies this record). INVENTORY.tsv lists each file with its size, SHA-256, the display items that use it, its source and its licence. No individual-level data or genotypes are included; the cell-level scDRS and scDeepID files carry anonymised cell identifiers.

Albert Henry, Anne Senabouth and Rika Tyebally contributed equally. Correspondence: Joseph E. Powell (j.powell@garvan.org.au).
